# TEZAUR 0.5.0

Local, citation-grounded thesis research assistant. This release adds bibliographic and indexing features that are all additive: with no flag and no environment variable set, behaviour is the same as 0.4.0.

## New features (all opt-in or additive)
- References: full BibTeX reader (`@string`, concatenation, months, `crossref`, entry types, warnings) and person-name parsing; RIS and CSL JSON import; richer CSL export; reference type crosswalk (BibTeX / CSL / RIS); persistent identifiers (DOI, ISBN, ISSN, ORCID); duplicate detection by DOI/ISBN (`bib --duplicates`, `--unify-duplicates`).
- Harvesting: polite Crossref client (pacing, retries, stop on 403, cache, retraction records, cursor paging); OAI-PMH harvest (`oai` command) with a minimal safe XML reader and Dublin Core mapping; `oai -o` never overwrites a non-empty file.
- Citation locators: labels, intervals, Roman numerals; a year is not read as a page. EPUB printed page numbers (page-list and pagebreak markers).
- Unicode index text (NFKD, mark folding, UAX #29 words, token positions).
- Exact phrase and proximity queries, off by default: `--phrases` or `TEZAUR_PHRASES=1`.
- Receipts v2 (RFC 8785 canonical digest/HMAC, SHA-256 document identity), off by default: `TEZAUR_RECEIPT_FORMAT=2`. The default stays `tezaur-receipt/1`; an unrecognised value prints a warning and uses format 1.
- FFF envelopes for the offline source chain (`ingest --fff-in`, `bib --fff-out`).
- Web UI in 8 languages (ro, en, fr, it, es, pt, de, hu) and accessibility work (names, keyboard citations, status regions, contrast, focus).

## Vendored pdf.js
- pdf.js is bundled locally for the PWA, the browser extension and the YunoHost package (no CDN fetch), with Subresource Integrity for the single-file build. Files are labelled Apache-2.0 (Mozilla copyright); `LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt` and `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` ship in release archives and the `.deb`.

## Fixes from the adversarial review
- OAI-PMH harvests are bounded (request cap, repeated resumption token, empty pages); the XML reader's unescape is linear and the XML size cap stays at 16 MB.
- `.bib` loading is linear (hash maps for duplicate-key and crossref lookups).
- `TEZAUR_PHRASES=1` is accepted as documented; compiler warnings and clippy errors are gone (`-D warnings` clean).
- Claims in the documentation were corrected (untested Zotero plugin labelled as such, offline wording, sidecar behaviour); placeholder container configs point at the image the repository publishes.

## Environment switches
- `TEZAUR_PHRASES=1` enables phrase and proximity queries (same as `--phrases`).
- `TEZAUR_RECEIPT_FORMAT=2` writes v2 receipts; unset or `1` keeps `tezaur-receipt/1`.

## Honest limits
- The model is yours; TEZAUR verifies citations mechanically, it does not prove claims.
- Server handles requests one at a time; page numbers of unpaginated sources (`.md`, `.txt`) cannot be checked.
- APT/RPM repositories are unsigned; store submissions (App Store, Google Play, Flathub, Snap Store, winget, Homebrew core) are not done. Packaging manifests for scoop, winget, Homebrew and the cask still carry placeholder checksums and are updated at tagging.

Binaries for Linux, macOS (arm64) and Windows plus a `.deb` and checksums are attached by the release workflow.

# TEZAUR 0.5.0 (română)

Asistent local de cercetare pentru teză, cu citări verificabile. Versiunea 0.5.0 adaugă cititor BibTeX complet, import RIS/CSL JSON, detectarea dublurilor, clienți Crossref și OAI-PMH, localizatori de citare, text Unicode în index, interogări de frază (`TEZAUR_PHRASES=1`), chitanțe v2 (`TEZAUR_RECEIPT_FORMAT=2`), interfață web în 8 limbi și pdf.js inclus local, plus corecturi din revizuirea adversarială. Comportamentul implicit rămâne neschimbat față de 0.4.0.
